route_note_consent: I agree to save this note in Atomic Memory so it is shown on my next reviews of this route.

ds_viz_description: Risk has a place on the route; figures show how it evolves. Mayu keeps risk colors distinct from comparative series.
ds_viz_map_description: Lima → Chosica → San Mateo → Ticlio → La Oroya → Jauja → Huancayo. Approximate alignment; the stretch to Huancayo continues along PE-3S.
ds_viz_map_label: Illustrative risk map for the Lima–Huancayo route
ds_viz_map_help: Select H1–H4 to inspect an advisory. Use the controls or + and − keys to zoom; arrow keys pan the map.
ds_viz_map_error: The full map could not load. Retry or read the advisories below.
ds_viz_risk_chart_description: Simulated advisory counts by horizon. Fixed order: low, moderate, high, and critical.
ds_viz_precipitation_description: Accumulation from now for three SENAMHI stations: Matucana, La Oroya, and Jauja. Simulated values.
ds_viz_rules: Use labeled risk-* tokens for risk and chart-* tokens for other series. Reserve brand-river and brand-starlight for identity.
app_description: Anticipate the risk. Protect your route.
ds_palette_surfaces_description: Deep river tones in dark mode; fresh, bright surfaces in light mode.
ds_palette_ink_description: Readable ink in both themes. Primary aqua identifies the main action.
ds_palette_risk_description: Low: leaf green, distinct from brand aqua. Moderate: yellow. High: orange. Critical: red. Always labeled.
ds_palette_status_description: Information / Success. System status is separate from route risk.
ds_palette_charts_description: Use chart-1 through chart-5 for non-risk series. Risk keeps its own colors and labels.
ds_palette_lines_description: Hairline borders separate layers; a full-strength aqua ring marks focus.
ds_palette_navigation_description: The sidebar has its own surface and shares the theme’s ink, action, border, and focus colors.
ds_color_description: Mayu brings together a deep river night, an aqua current, and starlight. Every surface has its own ink; contrast is measured in the active light or dark theme.
ds_color_contrast_guidance: AA requires 4.5:1 for regular text. Pairs below that threshold are flagged: use risk colors as fills with their paired text color, never as text on the canvas.
ds_components_description: Soft, predictable controls, visible states, and concrete messages. Try the fields, tabs, menus, and notifications; the examples work locally.
ds_buttons_description: One primary action per group. Use secondary and outline for alternatives, ghost and link for browsing, and destructive for deletion.
ds_icon_buttons: Icon only · With an accessible name
ds_fields_description: Persistent labels, useful guidance, and errors linked to the relevant field.
ds_search_route_hint: Search by road, city, or route code.
ds_incident_kilometer_error: Enter the kilometer marker, for example: 112.
ds_operator_notes_sample: Heavy rain on the approach to La Oroya. Confirm road conditions before dispatch.
ds_reference_source_hint: This information comes from the alert and cannot be edited.
ds_long_badge: Interoceánica · Puerto Maldonado · segment under review
ds_long_badge_hint: Long labels are truncated; the details retain the full name.
ds_route_card_alert: SUTRAN closure due to a debris flow. Check an alternative before dispatch.
ds_toast_source_opened: Demo: SUTRAN source for the confirmed closure.
ds_forecast_tab_description: SENAMHI orange warning: heavy rain expected on Chiclayo–Piura. Forecast window: 6 to 48 hours. Check conditions before departure.
ds_forecast_tooltip: An estimated forecast window; it does not confirm a road closure.
ds_toast_route_saved_description: Carretera Central added to your demo watchlist.
ds_toast_alert_updated_description: Interoceánica · Puerto Maldonado. Next review in 6 h.
ds_empty_description: Add a route to keep its alerts and recommendations in one place.
ds_toast_route_added: Carretera Central added to the demo.
ds_conversation_description: A short thread keeps the route, source, and recommendation together. Demo content.
ds_operator_message: Can we take Carretera Central to La Oroya?
ds_assistant_message: Critical risk at km 112: debris flow and a closure confirmed by SUTRAN. Recommendation: reroute. Clear the alternative with operations before dispatch.
ds_guidelines_description: Three Mayu rules that keep identity, risk, and action distinct when a decision cannot wait.
ds_brand_do_description: Low uses risk-low: leaf green with its matching ink, clearly distinct from brand aqua.
ds_brand_dont: Don't · Use brand colors for risk
ds_brand_dont_description: brand-river identifies Mayu. Never use it for a risk level, including “low.”
ds_label_do_description: The meaning stays clear even without color.
ds_unlabeled_indicator: Incorrect example: indicator without a visible label
ds_label_dont_description: A dot alone conveys neither severity nor cause.
ds_action_do_description: The decision stands out; supporting context stays close.
ds_action_dont_description: Two primary actions make the next step harder to choose.
ds_panel_section_title: From design system to route planning
ds_panel_section_description: Mayu in an operational screen: soft surfaces, precise data, and an actionable recommendation for each route.
ds_panel_description: Five routes. One view to plan your next move.
ds_panel_caption: Select a route to view its alert. Illustrative scenarios, not live data.
ds_panel_evidence_note: Every decision comes with evidence and a time horizon. Check that the alert is current before dispatch.
ds_hero_description: Anticipate the risk. Protect your route.
ds_risk_description: Leaf green, yellow, orange, and red retain the SENAMHI warning color names. Low stays distinct from Mayu aqua. Read the level, cause, and horizon together.
ds_risk_recommendation_note: Recommendations depend on the road segment and the evidence. Color alone does not determine an action.
ds_risk_diagram_caption: Risk by road segment · sample diagram
ds_critical_alert_description: Carretera Central km 112, La Oroya. Debris flow and SUTRAN closure. Now: reroute and validate the alternative before dispatch. Example scenario.
ds_high_alert_description: Panamericana Norte, Chiclayo–Piura. Heavy rain and a SENAMHI orange warning. Delay departure and check for updates. Example scenario; no closure has been confirmed.
ds_spacing_description: A 4 px spacing base, soft geometry, and hairline borders. Corner radii distinguish controls, surfaces, and circular elements without shadows.
ds_spacing_ladder: 8 px within a control; 16 px between items; 32 px between groups; 64 px between sections.
ds_radius_description: Use md (10 px) for controls, lg (14 px) for surfaces, and sm (6 px) for inner items. Use full for switches, radios, avatars, slider thumbs, progress tracks, and markers.
ds_card_surface_spec: Card surface · rounded-lg · hairline border · no shadow.
ds_popover_surface_spec: Popover surface · rounded-lg · hairline border · no shadow.
ds_dialog_surface_spec: Background surface · rounded-lg · hairline border · visible scrim.
ds_type_description: Archivo Expanded gives headings their force, Archivo keeps reading effortless, and JetBrains Mono brings precision to labels and figures. Headings, labels and buttons are uppercase; running text uses sentence case.
ds_type_caption: Contract: size / line height / weight / letter spacing. The active reading shows computed values at this viewport. Headings use Archivo at 125% width.
ds_type_paragraph_start: On Carretera Central, an alert should help you decide before departure. Check the
ds_type_paragraph_middle: , confirm the cause, and share the recommendation with your team. The code
ds_type_paragraph_end: keeps each alert linked to its route.
ds_meta_description: Mayu, ILLAPA’s visual system: a river of stars, soft geometry, and clarity to anticipate risk on Peru’s roads.
ds_route_diagram_label: Road segments with low, moderate, high, and critical risk, from left to right
ds_panel_recommendation: Recommendation: {recommendation}. Confirm road conditions and coordinate with operations before departure.
ds_tier_actions_description: Clear controls, one primary action, and explicit states.
ds_tier_inputs_description: Capture routes, forecast horizons, and preferences with labels and validation.
ds_tier_navigation_description: Consistent navigation across routes, sources, and alerts.
ds_tier_data_display_description: Operational information in panels, lists, and contained views.
ds_tier_feedback_description: Loading, progress, confirmations, and errors in context.
ds_tier_overlays_description: Open each example to try its interaction and dismissal.
ds_tier_conversation_description: Source-backed responses and questions that guide decisions.
ds_source_summary: SUTRAN confirms road closures; SENAMHI issues weather warnings.
ds_archive_description: This removes the alert from this demo view. It does not change real alerts.
ds_questionnaire_description: Two details to guide dispatch planning.
ds_trace_pending: Waiting for the next field report
ds_code_required: Enter all six digits of the code.
ds_type_lead_sample: Anticipate the risk. Protect your route.
ds_hero_concept: Mayu · The river of stars from which Illapa draws the rain. A calm interface for decisions under pressure.
ds_radius_inner: Menu items, calendar cells, and checkboxes
ds_radius_round: Switches, radios, avatars, progress, and markers
dashboard_incident_limit_description: Showing the {count} most recent incidents. Use the filters to narrow the search.
dashboard_incidents_empty_description: Try other categories or widen the time range.
dashboard_incidents_no_severity: Select at least one severity to see incidents.
account_sign_out_error: We couldn't sign you out. Try again.
ds_theme_switch_description: Light by default. A switch turns on dark mode; your preference is saved on this device.
ds_sidebar_description: A sidebar that expands or collapses to icons with tooltips. Theme, language, and account stay within reach; on phones, it opens as a drawer.
ds_logo_description: A raindrop carrying a starlight lightning bolt. The aqua mark and lowercase illapa wordmark identify the product; they never indicate risk.
ds_logo_mark_label: ILLAPA mark: raindrop with a lightning bolt
ds_logo_clear_space: Leave clear space equal to the bolt’s width on every side.
ds_logo_minimum_size: Minimum size: 16 px for the icon and 96 px wide for the full lockup.
ds_logo_colors: Use brand-river + brand-starlight or one solid colour. Never use risk colours.
ds_logo_geometry: Keep the original proportions and orientation. Never stretch or rotate the logo.
ds_logo_backgrounds: Always place a solid surface behind the logo when using it over photos or maps.
